traditions.displayName: Feng Shui — Earlier Heaven Ba Gua
traditions.shortDescription: The Fu Xi / Pre-Heaven arrangement: Qian→S, Dui→SE, Li→E, Zhen→NE, Xun→SW, Kan→W, Gen→NW, Kun→N. Opposite pairs face each other: Qian↔Kun (S↔N), Li↔Kan (E↔W), Dui↔Zhen (SE↔NE), Xun↔Gen (SW↔NW). Used in Ba Zhai and some talismanic traditions.
